# benoit-gaumard.io

> Benoit Gaumard, Azure Expert in Paris. Infrastructure as Code, Azure security, automation, 7 Microsoft certifications.

Personal site of Benoit Gaumard, Azure Infra & DevOps Consultant in Paris.
The reference datasets (Azure regions, IP ranges, policies, policy aliases,
taggable resources, release updates) are refreshed automatically by scheduled
GitHub Actions workflows, so the JSON behind each tool tracks upstream sources.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://benoit-gaumard.io/): Benoit Gaumard, Azure Expert in Paris. Infrastructure as Code, Azure security, automation, 7 Microsoft certifications.
- [Accueil (French)](https://benoit-gaumard.io/index_fr.html)
- [Articles](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/): index of every how-to guide
- [Tools](https://benoit-gaumard.io/tools/): index of every tool and reference page

## Articles

- [Allow ICMP (Ping) on an Azure VM](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/allow-icmp-ping-on-an-azure-vm/): Azure VMs block ICMP (ping) by default via the Windows Firewall. Here's the firewall rule to allow it, applied through the Azure portal's run command.
- [App Service (PHP) Access to Azure SQL Database with Managed Identity](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/app-service-php-access-to-azure-sql-database-with-managed-identity/): Connect a PHP app running on Azure App Service to Azure SQL Database using a system-assigned managed identity, with no stored username or password.
- [Azure REST APIs, Versions, and Lifecycle](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/azure-rest-apis-versions-and-lifecycle/): How Azure REST API versions work, how to find them with PowerShell, and why the api-version parameter matters.
- [Azure Subscription Switcher](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/azure-subscription-switcher/): A PowerShell script to quickly switch between Azure subscriptions by index, with an optional Out-GridView interface.
- [Terraform and Entra ID Authentication](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/azure-terraform-entra-id-authentication/): How to disable storage account key-based authentication and use Entra ID authentication for the Terraform azurerm remote backend.
- [Call Azure API with PowerShell](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/call-azure-api-with-powershell/): How to call an Azure REST API directly from PowerShell: get an access token, build the request headers, and invoke the endpoint.
- [RBAC Delete Role Assignments with 'Identity Not Found'](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/clean-rbac-identity-not-found/): Why Azure keeps RBAC role assignments for deleted users, groups, or service principals, and a PowerShell script to clean them up.
- [Connect to an Azure VM Using the Native RDP Client Through Bastion](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/connect-azure-vm-using-native-rdp-client-through-bastion/): Step-by-step guide to connecting to an Azure VM with your native RDP client through Azure Bastion's native client support, including how to open the tunnel with the Azure CLI.
- [Connect GitHub and Azure for Deployment Using OIDC](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/connect-github-and-azure-for-deployment-using-oidc/): Stop storing long-lived Azure credentials in GitHub secrets. Set up OpenID Connect federation so GitHub Actions can authenticate to Azure with short-lived tokens.
- [Cyber Attacks Live Maps](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/cyber-attacks-live-maps/): A curated list of free live dashboards that visualize cyber attacks happening around the world in real time.
- [Display GitHub Secrets for Debug](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/display-github-secrets-for-debug/): A quick method to print a GitHub Actions secret for debugging purposes, spaced out so it can't be read directly from the log.
- [Display Latest Commits with Git Graph](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/display-latest-commits-with-git-graph/): A stylish one-liner to showcase the latest commits from a repository directly in the terminal.
- [Don't Build Your Cloud Home on Shaky Foundations](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/dont-build-your-cloud-home-on-shaky-foundations/): Why cloud governance and security foundations - landing zones, management groups, policies, RBAC, naming, tagging, and networking - must come before any real workload.
- [Draw.io VS Code Extension: A Must-Have for Your Diagrams](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/draw-io-vscode-extension-a-must-have-for-your-diagrams/): Discover the benefits of integrating Draw.io with VS Code for seamless diagram creation.
- [From WordPress to Hugo Website](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/from-wordpress-to-hugo/): Why I migrated this site from WordPress to Hugo, and the trade-offs between the two platforms.
- [Git Basics](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/git-basics/): The fundamental Git commands every beginner should know: configuration, cloning, branching, committing, and logs.
- [GitHub Branch Naming Convention](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/github-branch-naming-convention/): A practical branch naming convention for GitHub projects: standard format, common prefixes, best practices, and special branches.
- [GitHub Commit Naming Convention](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/github-commit-naming-convention/): A practical commit message convention for GitHub projects, based on Conventional Commits: format, common types, and writing clear messages.
- [GitHub Contribution Workflow](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/github-contribution-workflow/): The end-to-end workflow for contributing to a GitHub project: fork, branch, commit, push, pull request, code review, and merge.
- [How to Create a New Article](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/how-to-creat-a-new-article/): Everything you can use when writing a new article for /articles: frontmatter fields, headings, lists, callouts, code blocks, tables, images, and links.
- [How to Delegate a Domain to Azure DNS](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/how-to-delegate-a-domain-to-azure-dns/): Step-by-step guide to delegating a domain purchased from a third-party registrar (OVH) to Azure DNS, and recreating the DNS records once delegation is complete.
- [How to Embed a GitHub Script in an Article](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/how-to-embed-a-github-script-in-an-article/): How I keep long PowerShell scripts in a dedicated GitHub repository and embed them directly as code blocks instead of duplicating the code across posts.
- [How to Host Your Hugo Website on GitHub Pages](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/how-to-host-your-hugo-website-on-github-pages/): Step-by-step guide to publishing a local Hugo website to GitHub Pages, including the deployment pipeline and how to sync content updates.
- [KQL Query Collection](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/kql-query-collection/): A growing collection of Kusto Query Language (KQL) queries for Azure Resource Graph, covering AKS, disks, networking, policies, RBAC, subscriptions, and tags.
- [Network Security Perimeter (NSP)](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/network-security-perimeter/): An overview of Azure Network Security Perimeter: the pain points it solves for PaaS resource access control, how it compares to existing patterns, and its current limitations.
- [Optimize and Reduce Costs in Azure](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/optimize-and-reduce-costs-in-azure/): Practical tips to control and reduce your Azure spending: VM sizing, autoshutdown, reservations, hybrid benefit, storage tiers, tagging, and more.
- [Remove Old Azure Resources Based on Tags](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/remove-old-azure-resources-based-on-tags/): Automate the cleanup of temporary Azure resources using a Time-To-Live tag, plus a script to auto-tag untagged resources with their creator.
- [Restrict Web App Access with Entra ID Authentication](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/restrict-web-app-access-with-entra-id-authentication/): How to restrict access to an Azure Web App to specific users or security groups using Microsoft Entra ID, instead of allowing every user in the tenant.
- [Search Azure Policy Aliases and Send Output to an Interactive Table](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/search-azure-policy-aliases/): A PowerShell script that lets you interactively search Azure Policy aliases by namespace using Out-GridView.
- [Set Up Your First Terraform Environment on Windows](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/set-up-your-first-terraform-environment-on-windows/): Step-by-step guide to setting up your first Terraform environment on Windows: install the CLI, configure a remote state backend in Azure Storage, and run your first plan and apply.
- [Terraform vs Bicep, the Match](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/terraform-vs-bicep-the-match/): A side-by-side comparison of Terraform and Bicep across language, state management, learning curve, cost, and more, based on hands-on experience with both.
- [What Is an Azure Landing Zone?](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/what-is-an-azure-landing-zone/): A practical introduction to Azure landing zones: what they are, why they matter, and the building blocks every platform team should know.

## Tools and reference data

- [AWS Release Updates](https://benoit-gaumard.io/aws-release-updates/): Latest AWS service updates from the official AWS What's New RSS feed, refreshed automatically.
- [Azure IP Ranges](https://benoit-gaumard.io/azure-ip-ranges/): IP address ranges used by Azure services (service tags), fetched from the Azure IP Ranges and Service Tags - Public Cloud download.
- [Azure Naming Convention](https://benoit-gaumard.io/azure-naming-convention/): Generate Azure resource names following the Cloud Adoption Framework naming convention, and browse recommended resource type abbreviations.
- [Azure Policies](https://benoit-gaumard.io/azure-policies/): Browse all built-in Azure Policy definitions and initiatives (policy sets), refreshed directly from Azure.
- [Azure Policy Aliases](https://benoit-gaumard.io/azure-policy-aliases/): Search all supported Azure Policy aliases to use when authoring custom Azure Policy definitions.
- [Azure Regions](https://benoit-gaumard.io/azure-regions/): Explore Azure datacenter locations and regional information worldwide: physical location, geography, paired region, and availability zone support.
- [Azure Release Updates](https://benoit-gaumard.io/azure-release-updates/): Latest Azure service updates from the official Azure Updates RSS feed, refreshed twice daily.
- [Azure Taggable Resources](https://benoit-gaumard.io/azure-taggable-resources/): Check which Azure resource types support tags and whether tags appear in the cost report, sourced from the official tag-support reference data.
- [Emoji Sheet](https://benoit-gaumard.io/emoji-sheet/): Complete collection of emojis with their shortcodes. Click to copy.
- [My Favorite Links](https://benoit-gaumard.io/favorite-links/): A curated collection of useful links and resources.
- [My Friends' Websites](https://benoit-gaumard.io/friends-websites/): Discover amazing websites from my network of friends and colleagues.
- [GitHub IP Ranges](https://benoit-gaumard.io/github-ip-ranges/): IP address ranges used by GitHub services (web, API, git, Actions, Pages, Copilot, and more), fetched directly from the GitHub Meta API.
- [GUID Generator](https://benoit-gaumard.io/guid-generator/): Generate one or many random GUIDs / UUIDs (v4), with options for uppercase, hyphens, braces, and quotes.
- [Azure SVG Icon Gallery](https://benoit-gaumard.io/icons/): Browse and download a curated gallery of Azure SVG icons.
- [IT Images &amp; Memes](https://benoit-gaumard.io/it-images/): A collection of funny IT memes, developer humor, and tech-related images.
- [M365 Release Updates](https://benoit-gaumard.io/m365-release-updates/): Latest Microsoft 365 roadmap updates from the official Microsoft 365 RSS feed, refreshed twice daily.
- [Microsoft Portals](https://benoit-gaumard.io/microsoft-portals/): A comprehensive directory of all Microsoft portals in one place.
- [Microsoft Techcommunity RSS Feeds](https://benoit-gaumard.io/microsoft-techcommunity-rss-feeds/): Consolidate latest activities from Microsoft Tech Community blogs.
- [Percentage Calculator](https://benoit-gaumard.io/percentage-calculator/): Calculate percentages: what is X% of Y, what percent X is of Y, percentage change between two values, and add or subtract a percentage from a value.
- [Random Wheel](https://benoit-gaumard.io/random-wheel/): Spin a wheel to generate a random letter (A-Z) or number (0-100). Already picked values are excluded until you reset.
- [RSS Watcher](https://benoit-gaumard.io/rss-watcher/): An RSS aggregator that reads tech news of the moment from many sites at once, refreshed automatically throughout the day.
- [Feeds Activity | RSS Watcher](https://benoit-gaumard.io/rss-watcher/activity/): Overview of all RSS feeds tracked by RSS Watcher and their latest publication dates.
- [SLA Calculator](https://benoit-gaumard.io/sla-calculator/): Calculate allowed downtime for any SLA percentage, reverse-calculate an SLA from real downtime, and combine multiple dependent service SLAs into a composite uptime target.
- [Subnet Calculator](https://benoit-gaumard.io/subnet-calculator/): Calculate IPv4 subnet details from an IP address and CIDR prefix or subnet mask, and split a network into equal-sized subnets.
- [Tools](https://benoit-gaumard.io/tools/): A collection of small tools and reference pages built by Benoit Gaumard.
- [Units Converter](https://benoit-gaumard.io/units-converter/): Convert between common units of length, weight, temperature, volume, speed, area, data, and time.
- [Workflows](https://benoit-gaumard.io/workflows/): Live status of the scheduled GitHub Actions workflows that refresh Azure, M365, RSS Watcher, GitHub IP Ranges, and Azure IP Ranges data across this site.
- [World Clock](https://benoit-gaumard.io/world-clock/): Current time and date in Paris, plus a glance at colleague timezones around the world.
